decision.explanation: Both 'Academy of Fine Arts, Prague (AVU)' and 'Adelphi University' are explicitly stated in the original sources as institutions attended by Harry J. Mott, III. Document d1 (D1S9) states he attended AVU from 1973 to 1975, while document d2 (D2S22) affirms his attendance at Adelphi University. These are distinct educational experiences and both are directly supported by the provided texts. There is no evidence in the sources to exclude either as valid answers.
